name: Wall Gallery
summary:
Turn a folder of photos, illustrations and videos into your own walk-through museum. Adjust artwork size and spacing, or jump to a piece from its thumbnail.

THREE WAYS TO DISPLAY
• Folder Gallery: Choose a folder for automatic exhibition.
• Curated Gallery: Name a museum and arrange artwork and frames yourself.
• Display in Your Room: Place artwork on real walls using mixed reality.
